description: This file is a server-side PHP script that handles the display of campaign tracking details within the SuiteCRM platform. It manages loading campaign data, rendering detailed views with Smarty templates, generating charts, and handling subpanels for related data like email marketing and leads.

classes.name: campaign_charts
classes.description: A class responsible for generating campaign response charts for visualization in the dashboard.

classes.name: SubPanelTiles
classes.description: A class that manages the rendering and filtering of subpanels related to a campaign, such as leads and email marketing.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Method of DetailView that processes and retrieves the sample Bean object based on request parameters.

methods.name: campaign_response_by_activity_type
methods.description: Method of campaign_charts class that generates XML data for plotting campaign response statistics.

methods.name: getChartResources
methods.description: Method of SugarChartFactory that provides necessary resources for rendering charts.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Method of SubPanelTiles that renders the subpanel HTML content.
